confidence.reason: Rate-limiter ownership and reset behavior are explicit in source; multi-replica request distribution was not executed in this source-only run.

description: Request throttling uses a process-local in-memory RateLimiter registry owned by each application process. In a multi-replica hosted deployment, each replica enforces the same nominal per-IP bucket independently, so aggregate traffic across replicas can exceed the intended shared limit.

evidence.description: Registry is explicitly per caller/process and isolated between app instances in the same process.
main.py owns one process-wide registry; no shared/distributed throttle state.
Throttling is explicitly hosted-only and relies on this registry.
Supported deployment discussions contemplate web replicas/workers sharing load while throttle state remains local.

execution.attacker_perspective: Unauthenticated remote client able to distribute requests across web replicas.
instructions: Deploy hosted mode with more than one web replica behind the proxy.
Send login/callback/sync/cache-clear requests at the nominal per-IP limit toward each replica identity.
Observe that each replica accepts up to its local bucket, so aggregate accepted requests exceed the nominal shared bucket.
Confirm that no shared throttle store coordinates the replicas.
execution.observed_result: Aggregate accepted abusive requests scale with replica count because each replica maintains an independent token bucket.
payloads: Repeated POST /api/auth/login/start, GET /api/auth/callback failures, POST /api/sync, DELETE /api/cache and DELETE /api/me/cache at the nominal per-IP limit per replica

intended_behavior: Abuse throttling for internet-facing authentication, sync, and destructive endpoints should enforce the intended shared limit regardless of how many web replicas accept traffic.

code_changes.fixed_code: Replace the process-local RateLimiter for internet-facing buckets with shared throttle state, or document the deployment as single-web-replica-only and enforce that topology in compose/deployment checks.

remediation.strategy: Use shared rate-limit state for externally reachable buckets when multiple web replicas are supported; otherwise constrain the supported topology to one web replica and check it at deployment time.

root_cause: Process-local in-memory rate-limit buckets with no shared coordination across web replicas.

impact.reason: Abuse controls weaken as replicas scale; this permits more abusive throughput but does not itself bypass authentication or expose another tenant.

likelihood.reason: Requires a multi-replica deployment and distributed abusive traffic; single-replica deployments and Cloudflare edge controls reduce exposure.

title: In-memory rate limits diverge across web replicas

trace.description: Throttle registry is instantiated per application process.
Registry implementation is explicitly process-local and isolated.
Internet-facing login/callback/sync/cache endpoints consume the local bucket.
No shared throttle coordination; aggregate limit scales with replica count.
